newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet holds steady, but buying still scarce.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet holds steady, but buying still scarce.

text.p: European jet was steady on Friday amid unchanged premiums and gas oil futures.
April IPE gas oil was unchanged at $173.25 at 1545 GMT.
Physical activity was slow with barge premiums talked around April IPE +$17-18 fob ARA amid some length of product.
Cargoes in NWE were between April IPE gas oil +$21-24 cif NWE depending on cargo size and loading dates while April swaps were heard around +$24.
In the Mediterranean EC spec jet was hovering around fob high quotes +$8 while Libyan was in the fob high quotes +$4-5 range.
Significant fresh demand from the main airline buyers was not anticipated until well into April, traders said.
